name: linearFractionalMap_bottomRight_of_mul_eq_one
statement:
private lemma linearFractionalMap_bottomRight_of_mul_eq_one
    {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (b c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (d : ℝ)
    (Ainv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (binv cinv : Fin n → ℝ)
    (dinv : ℝ)
    (hQinv :
      Matrix.fromBlocks A (fun i _ => b i) (fun _ j => c j) (fun _ _ => d) *
        Matrix.fromBlocks Ainv (fun i _ => binv i) (fun _ j => cinv j) (fun _ _ => dinv) =
        (1 : Matrix (Fin n ⊕ Unit) (Fin n ⊕ Unit) ℝ)) :
    dotProduct c binv + d * dinv = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congr_fun (congr_fun hQinv (Sum.inr ())) (Sum.inr ())
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.fromBlocks, dotProduct] using h

name: linearFractionalMap_bottomLeft_of_mul_eq_one
statement:
private lemma linearFractionalMap_bottomLeft_of_mul_eq_one
    {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (b c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (d : ℝ)
    (Ainv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (binv cinv : Fin n → ℝ)
    (dinv : ℝ)
    (hQinv :
      Matrix.fromBlocks A (fun i _ => b i) (fun _ j => c j) (fun _ _ => d) *
        Matrix.fromBlocks Ainv (fun i _ => binv i) (fun _ j => cinv j) (fun _ _ => dinv) =
        (1 : Matrix (Fin n ⊕ Unit) (Fin n ⊕ Unit) ℝ)) :
    ∀ j : Fin n, dotProduct c (fun i => Ainv i j) + d * cinv j = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  have h := congr_fun (congr_fun hQinv (Sum.inr ())) (Sum.inl j)
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.fromBlocks, dotProduct] using h

name: linearFractionalMap_inverse_mem_domain
statement:
private lemma linearFractionalMap_inverse_mem_domain
    {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (b c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (d : ℝ)
    (Ainv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (binv cinv : Fin n → ℝ)
    (dinv : ℝ)
    (hQinv :
      Matrix.fromBlocks A (fun i _ => b i) (fun _ j => c j) (fun _ _ => d) *
        Matrix.fromBlocks Ainv (fun i _ => binv i) (fun _ j => cinv j) (fun _ _ => dinv) =
        (1 : Matrix (Fin n ⊕ Unit) (Fin n ⊕ Unit) ℝ))
    (y : {y : Fin n → ℝ // dotProduct cinv y + dinv > 0}) :
    dotProduct c (linearFractionalMap Ainv binv cinv dinv y) + d > 0
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℝ := dotProduct cinv y.1 + dinv
  have hs_pos : 0 < s := y.2
  have hs_ne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs_pos
  have hleft : ∀ j : Fin n, dotProduct c (fun i => Ainv i j) + d * cinv j = 0 :=
    linearFractionalMap_bottomLeft_of_mul_eq_one A b c d Ainv binv cinv dinv hQinv
  have hright : dotProduct c binv + d * dinv = 1 :=
    linearFractionalMap_bottomRight_of_mul_eq_one A b c d Ainv binv cinv dinv hQinv
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : Fin n, c i * ∑ j : Fin n, Ainv i j * y.1 j) =
        ∑ j : Fin n, y.1 j * ∑ i : Fin n, c i * Ainv i j := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin n, c i * ∑ j : Fin n, Ainv i j * y.1 j)
          = ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, c i * (Ainv i j * y.1 j) := by
            simp [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ j : Fin n, ∑ i : Fin n, c i * (Ainv i j * y.1 j) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      _ = ∑ j : Fin n, y.1 j * ∑ i : Fin n, c i * Ainv i j := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j hj
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i hi
            ring
  have hcoeff :
      (∑ i : Fin n, c i * ((∑ j : Fin n, Ainv i j * y.1 j) + binv i)) +
          d * ((∑ j : Fin n, cinv j * y.1 j) + dinv) = 1 := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin n, c i * ((∑ j : Fin n, Ainv i j * y.1 j) + binv i)) +
          d * ((∑ j : Fin n, cinv j * y.1 j) + dinv)
          = (∑ j : Fin n, y.1 j *
              (dotProduct c (fun i => Ainv i j) + d * cinv j)) +
              (dotProduct c binv + d * dinv) := by
            simp [dotProduct]
            calc
              ∑ x, c x * (∑ x_1, Ainv x x_1 * y.1 x_1 + binv x) +
                  d * (∑ x, cinv x * y.1 x + dinv)
                  = (∑ x, c x * ∑ x_1, Ainv x x_1 * y.1 x_1) +
                      (∑ x, c x * binv x) +
                      (d * ∑ x, cinv x * y.1 x + d * dinv) := by
                    simp [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
              _ = (∑ x, y.1 x * ∑ x_1, c x_1 * Ainv x_1 x) +
                      (∑ x, c x * binv x) +
                      (d * ∑ x, cinv x * y.1 x + d * dinv) := by
                    rw [hsum]
              _ = ∑ x, y.1 x * (∑ x_1, c x_1 * Ainv x_1 x + d * cinv x) +
                      (∑ i, c i * binv i + d * dinv) := by
                    simp [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
                    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
                    ring_nf
                    congr 1
                    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                    intro i hi
                    ring
      _ = 1 := by
            simp [hleft, hright]
  have hmap :
      dotProduct c (linearFractionalMap Ainv binv cinv dinv y) =
        (∑ i : Fin n, c i * ((∑ j : Fin n, Ainv i j * y.1 j) + binv i)) / s := by
    rw [show s = (∑ j : Fin n, cinv j * y.1 j) + dinv by simp [s, dotProduct]]
    simp [linearFractionalMap, dotProduct, div_eq_mul_inv]
    calc
      ∑ x, c x * ((∑ x_1, Ainv x x_1 * y.1 x_1 + binv x) *
          (∑ x, cinv x * y.1 x + dinv)⁻¹)
          = ∑ x, (c x * (∑ x_1, Ainv x x_1 * y.1 x_1 + binv x)) *
              (∑ x, cinv x * y.1 x + dinv)⁻¹ := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i hi
            ring
      _ = (∑ x, c x * (∑ x_1, Ainv x x_1 * y.1 x_1 + binv x)) *
          (∑ x, cinv x * y.1 x + dinv)⁻¹ := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  have hmul :
      s * (dotProduct c (linearFractionalMap Ainv binv cinv dinv y) + d) = 1 := by
    rw [hmap]
    field_simp [hs_ne]
    rw [show s = (∑ j : Fin n, cinv j * y.1 j) + dinv by simp [s, dotProduct]]
    linarith [hcoeff]
  nlinarith

name: polyhedralInner_outer_approximation
statement:
theorem polyhedralInner_outer_approximation
    {n K : ℕ}
    (C : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
    (hC_closed : IsClosed C)
    (hC_convex : Convex ℝ C)
    (x : Fin K → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx_boundary : ∀ i, x i ∈ frontier C)
    (hx_mem : ∀ i, x i ∈ C)
    (a : Fin K → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (h_supports : ∀ i, SupportsHyperplane C (x i) (a i)) :
    convexHullOfPoints x ⊆ C ∧
      C ⊆ {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) | ∀ i : Fin K, ⟪a i, y - x i⟫ ≤ 0}

name: DifferentiableNonlinearProgram.nonlinear_for_toNonlinearProgram
statement:
private lemma DifferentiableNonlinearProgram.nonlinear_for_toNonlinearProgram
    {n : ℕ} (P : DifferentiableNonlinearProgram n) :
    ¬ ((∃ a : (Fin n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, P.f = a) ∧
      (∀ i : P.equalityIndex, ∃ a : (Fin n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, P.equalityConstraint i = a) ∧
      (∀ i : P.inequalityIndex, ∃ a : (Fin n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, P.inequalityConstraint i = a))

name: quadratic_constrained_linear_program_unique_solution
statement:
theorem quadratic_constrained_linear_program_unique_solution
    {n m : ℕ}
    (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (fHess : (Fin n → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (fGrad : (Fin n → ℝ) → Fin n → ℝ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (b : Fin m → ℝ)
    (xHat Δx : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hconvex : Convex ℝ (Set.univ : Set (Fin n → ℝ)))
    (hC2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (hArank : Module.rank ℝ (Fin m → ℝ) = m)
    (hxb : A.mulVec xHat = b)
    (hstep : newtonStep f fHess fGrad A xHat Δx)
    (hKKT :
      ∃! z : (Fin n → ℝ) × (Fin m → ℝ),
        (fHess xHat).mulVec z.1 + A.transpose.mulVec z.2 = -(fGrad xHat) ∧
          A.mulVec z.1 = 0)
    (hdec : ℝ := newtonDecrement f fHess fGrad A xHat ⟨Δx, hstep⟩)
    (hdec_eq : hdec = Real.sqrt (-∑ i, fGrad xHat i * Δx i))
    (hKKT_nonsingular : ∃! z : (Fin n → ℝ) × (Fin m → ℝ),
      (fHess xHat).mulVec z.1 + A.transpose.mulVec z.2 = -(fGrad xHat) ∧
        A.mulVec z.1 = 0)
    (hlam_pos : 0 < hdec) :
    ∃! y : Fin n → ℝ,
      A.mulVec y = 0 ∧
        (∑ i, y i * ∑ j, fHess xHat i j * y j) ≤ 1 ∧
        (∀ z : Fin n → ℝ,
          A.mulVec z = 0 ∧
            (∑ i, z i * ∑ j, fHess xHat i j * z j) ≤ 1 →
          (∑ i, fGrad xHat i * y i) ≤ ∑ i, fGrad xHat i * z i) ∧
        y = fun i => Δx i / hdec

name: GeometricProgram.log_change_yields_convex_problem
proof:
:= by
  have hfeasible : Convex ℝ P.logTransformedFeasibleSet :=
    P.logTransformedFeasibleSet_convex
  refine ⟨?_, hfeasible, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [GeometricProgram.logTransformedObjective, GeometricProgram.logChange] using
      isPosynomial_logTransform_convexOn P.objective_is_posynomial hfeasible
  · intro g hg
    simpa [GeometricProgram.logTransformedInequality, GeometricProgram.logChange] using
      isPosynomial_logTransform_convexOn (P.inequalities_are_posynomial g hg) hfeasible
  · intro h hh
    simpa [GeometricProgram.logTransformedEquality, GeometricProgram.logChange] using
      isMonomial_logTransform_affine (P.equalities_are_monomial h hh)

name: aTilde_sub_bTilde_eq_div
statement:
private lemma aTilde_sub_bTilde_eq_div
    {n N M : ℕ}
    (p : MaximumMarginSeparationProblem n N M)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ⟪p.aTilde, u⟫ - p.bTilde = (⟪p.a, u⟫ - p.b) / p.t
proof:
:= by
  simp [MaximumMarginSeparationProblem.aTilde, MaximumMarginSeparationProblem.bTilde,
    div_eq_mul_inv, inner_smul_left, sub_eq_add_neg, mul_add, mul_comm]

name: x_separation_from_margin
statement:
private lemma x_separation_from_margin
    {n N M : ℕ}
    (p : MaximumMarginSeparationProblem n N M)
    (i : Fin N) :
    ⟪p.aTilde, p.x i⟫ - p.bTilde ≥ 1
proof:
:= by
  have ht : 0 < p.t := p.data.pos_t
  have ht_ne : p.t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
  have hscaled : 1 ≤ (⟪p.a, p.x i⟫ - p.b) / p.t := by
    have hdiv :
        p.t / p.t ≤ (⟪p.a, p.x i⟫ - p.b) / p.t :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (p.data.x_margin i) (le_of_lt ht)
    simpa [div_self ht_ne] using hdiv
  calc
    ⟪p.aTilde, p.x i⟫ - p.bTilde = (⟪p.a, p.x i⟫ - p.b) / p.t :=
      aTilde_sub_bTilde_eq_div p (p.x i)
    _ ≥ 1 := hscaled

name: y_separation_from_margin
statement:
private lemma y_separation_from_margin
    {n N M : ℕ}
    (p : MaximumMarginSeparationProblem n N M)
    (j : Fin M) :
    ⟪p.aTilde, p.y j⟫ - p.bTilde ≤ -1
proof:
:= by
  have ht : 0 < p.t := p.data.pos_t
  have ht_ne : p.t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
  have hscaled : (⟪p.a, p.y j⟫ - p.b) / p.t ≤ -1 := by
    have hdiv :
        (⟪p.a, p.y j⟫ - p.b) / p.t ≤ (-p.t) / p.t :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (p.data.y_margin j) (le_of_lt ht)
    have hneg : (-p.t) / p.t = (-1 : ℝ) := by
      field_simp [ht_ne]
    simpa [hneg] using hdiv
  calc
    ⟪p.aTilde, p.y j⟫ - p.bTilde = (⟪p.a, p.y j⟫ - p.b) / p.t :=
      aTilde_sub_bTilde_eq_div p (p.y j)
    _ ≤ -1 := hscaled

name: Kmplus_isProperCone
statement:
theorem Kmplus_isProperCone :
    IsProperCone
      ({x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) |
          (∀ i j : Fin n, i ≤ j → x i ≥ x j) ∧ (∀ i : Fin n, 0 ≤ x i)} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
